applies_to: New supplemental phase2/3 large log/freeze files; original raw-part format and existing frozen evidence remain unchanged.
no_acceptance_change: This changes storage encoding only, never source proofs, runner guards, artifact acceptance, actual exit statuses, or final fresh-launch prerequisites.

part_encoding.text_encoding: Standard RFC4648 base64 wrapped at76ASCII columns with LF
part_encoding.underlying_bytes: The one compressed XZ stream, partitioned in order.

retention: All ordered base64 parts, original/compressed/part identity manifests and reconstruction/arrival receipts are permanent semantic archive evidence, explicitly included in Git allowlists. Large reconstructed raw bodies can remain outside Git while their exact lossless part representation remains committed.
selection: For an explicitly inventoried original file, use a single standard XZ stream at preset3/CRC64 if measured compressed size is smaller; otherwise retain the existing raw-part format. Record selected encoding for each original.
verification: Require regular no-symlink source and unique absent destination; pre/post source stat and SHA equality.
Verify all stored and decoded part hashes, exact contiguous compressed offsets and exact compressed whole length/SHA.

Decompress exactly one XZ stream; require decoder eof, empty unused_data, expected original total length and original SHA. Reject any output beyond declared original length and any trailing or concatenated stream.
Destination reconstructs the full original byte body independently and verifies exact byte count/SHA. Fsync new evidence files and their parent directories before reporting durable receipt.
No existing file is overwritten; source/runtime/build/proof files are read only. Missing/partial original evidence remains explicitly missing/partial.
